prompt: What does a Texas driver approaching an official YIELD sign legally have to do under TTC §545.153?

options.text: Come to a complete mandatory halt regardless of roadway traffic conditions
Maintain posted cruising speed while signaling intent with hazard flashers
Accelerate swiftly into the merging lane to force traffic to create room
Slow down to a reasonable speed and stop if necessary to yield to traffic
